tmsi.description: Starts a call stack for tmjc and tmjr at stack address base (2 to 511), growing down. Each call saves r0 up to r(count-1), count 0 to 16, and the line to return to. Sets ra to the stack's top. Run it before the first tmjc, at the start of the program.

tmjc.description: Calls a function: saves the line to return to and the registers tmsi chose on the call stack, puts up to five values a-e into r0-r4, and jumps to the line or label. tmjr's value goes into the register r? (r0 to r15).

tmjr.description: Returns from the last tmjc: restores the registers it saved and ra, puts the value (if given) into tmjc's register, and jumps to the line after the tmjc.
